capture.reading: an armed run derives the whole record again, writes only when a value moved, and states no head but the one it ran at; a default run derives the same record at the head the file names and asserts the committed bytes are exactly that serialization, so a value that moved is named by path and field and the record cannot drift from the tree without failing. A head that predates a change in a file this record measures is refused, naming both heads (SC4).
